obs: Case v. Los Angeles Lumber Products Co.
"Such procedure would deprive scattered and unorganized security holders of the protection which the Congress had provided them under 77B."

"But in any event it is immaterial that there may have been a prior custom or contract... The Fair Labor Standards Act was not designed to codify or perpetuate those customs and contracts... Any custom or contract falling short of that basic policy... cannot be utilized to deprive employees of their statutory rights."
